discourse_text: Phones should not be used while driving because it is dangerous
full_text:
Phones should not be used while driving because it is dangerous. When you look at your phone you are not looking at the road and that is how accidents happen. My uncle got in a crash once because he was texting.

In conclusion drivers need to put the phone away.

discourse_text: Dear Senator, I believe we should keep the Electoral College because it makes candidates pay attention to every region
full_text: Dear Senator, I believe we should keep the Electoral College because it makes candidates pay attention to every region. Without it, the big states would decide every election and the small states would be ignored by everyone running for president.
